**BiliMind Desktop:** drop in your files, type one sentence, get a course checked against them.

For Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit).

## Which file to download

- **`BiliMind-Desktop-…-x64-portable.exe`**: no install. Download it and double-click it to run.
- **`BiliMind-Desktop-…-x64-setup.exe`**: installs the app, with a Start menu entry and a desktop shortcut.

Pick one. Both are the same app.

## "Windows protected your PC"

The app is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show this message the first time.
Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## No account, no key

The app uses **BiliMind free** for the AI, so you do not need an account or an API key.
If you have your own DeepSeek or OpenRouter key, you can add it in Settings, but you don't need one.

## First run

1. Drop your files or a whole folder: lecture slides, a past paper, notes or an SOP.
2. Type one sentence, for example: "My Data Structures final is Wednesday 9am. I have 45 minutes a day. Get me ready."
3. Click **Build my course**. It takes a few minutes. You can watch each step as it runs.
